note: Health is squarely the neglected area — a decade of two-month training cycles, weight gained during COVID and never lost, and he has never had a coach of any kind, which is the textbook version of this criterion. He is also not the excluded profile: he loves training, does compound barbell work, fasts deliberately and had already bought a kettlebell and started using it. He misses on income — he expected six months to cost around SAR 8,000 (~$2,000), said plainly 'I feel it's too much', and the deal now depends on whether he can withdraw from an existing monthly financial commitment. He misses on good-to-great: he is trying to recover a baseline he held before COVID, not to move from good to excellent, and the presenting problem is consistency rather than optimisation. 'Successful' is untested, not failed — occupation was never asked once across 48 minutes, which is a qualification failure given the ICP screens on exactly that.
